miroirs.name: Le palais des glaces
miroirs.alt: The entrance hall of a hall of mirrors under a red-and-white striped tent, painted in ink and gouache: a ticket booth with a striped awning whose window shows a cabinet of little cubbies, a giant filling a tall mirror, a mouse seeing itself huge in a wobbly mirror while the real tiny mouse sits below, a boy rolling a round red ball, a ladybird in sunglasses on a stool, and an oval mirror that makes the hall look a mile long with a far-away mouse waving. The tent curtain on the left opens onto the park; on the right a gilt archway leads to the mirror corridor and wooden stairs climb to the upper floor.

doors.label: Le couloir
doors.hint: Go through the gilt archway into the corridor of mirrors

doors.label: L'étage
doors.hint: Climb the wooden stairs to the upper floor

zooms.label: le guichet
zooms.hint: Look closer at the ticket booth's cabinet of curiosities

guichet.name: Le guichet
guichet.alt: Close-up of the ticket kiosk in the hall of mirrors: under the red-and-white scalloped striped awning, with the striped tent and fairy lights behind, the wooden plank kiosk frames a cabinet of twelve cubbies. A gigantic hamster at a doll's desk, an elephant filling its cubby, a cat with a magnifier spotting a tiny scratch on a mirror, an acrobat on a taut tightrope, a shopkeeper plonking any old hat on a boy, owls in a hollow stump, an elephant seeing himself tiny in a hand mirror, a compass pointing east, a terrier gripping a rope toy, a chalkboard with a crossed-out laughing face, a poodle beside a framed lighthouse, and a crowned cat lounging on a cushion. The gilt frames of the mouse mirror and the giant's mirror show at either side.

couloir.name: Le couloir des miroirs
couloir.alt: A corridor of tall mirrors under the striped tent, painted in ink and gouache: a giant in a mirror hopping with a red sore toe and pain stars, a mirror showing a diver sinking into deep water, a magician zapping a spark that lights up her mirror, a girl paying a coin for a very thick slice of cake, and a round gentleman gasping at his tight belt. An archway on the left leads back to the hall; stairs on the right go up to the upper floor.

doors.label: Le palais des glaces
doors.hint: Back through the archway to the entrance hall

doors.label: L'étage
doors.hint: Climb the far stairs to the upper floor

etage.name: L'étage
etage.alt: The upper floor of the hall of mirrors, painted in ink and gouache: a peasant boy staggering under a heavy sack, a sloth hanging perfectly flat between two mirror frames, a colossal mirror mouse towering over a tiny real mouse, a round ginger cat, a mirror where one snail echoes into a hundred down a spacious hall, and a mirror showing a mouse on one side and a mighty lion on the other. Stairs on the left lead down; on the right a wide wooden display case holds a lit diorama.

doors.label: Le palais des glaces
doors.hint: Go back down the stairs to the entrance hall

zooms.label: la vitrine
zooms.hint: Look closer at the diorama in the display case

vitrine.name: La vitrine
vitrine.alt: Close-up through the glass of the display case: a toy diorama on a three-tier stand. A rectangular mirror stretching a round cat into a loaf, a sprinter with a lightning bolt behind his trainers, a grumpy mouse's shop with one shelf and one sock, a bee on a honeycomb shaped like France, a tin robot whose magnet chest yanks spoons and keys, identical sheep following each other into the mist, and a little train squeezed onto tight narrow tracks.
